title: kith-store: MessageStore
description:
MessageStore: insert, query, delivery state updates, JMAP state tokens for Message type.

**What:** MessageStore wraps &Connection and implements message persistence with ULID-based IDs, ordering by created_at, delivery state machine, and Message/changes support.

**Algorithm:**
1. Define pub struct MessageStore<'a> { conn: &'a Connection }
2. insert(msg: &Message, created_at_unix: i64) -> Result<(), KithError>:
   INSERT INTO messages(id, chat_id, sender_user_id, body, body_type, sent_at_peer, created_at, delivery_state, reply_to) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?); advance state
3. get(id: &str) -> Result<Option<Message>, KithError>: SELECT by PK, map to Message
4. list_by_chat(chat_id: &str, limit: u32) -> Result<Vec<Message>, KithError>: SELECT WHERE chat_id=? ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT ? (uses messages_chat_time index)
5. update_delivery_state(id: &str, state: &DeliveryState, delivered_at: Option<i64>) -> Result<(), KithError>: UPDATE delivery_state and delivered_at; advance state
6. update_read_at(id: &str, read_at: i64) -> Result<(), KithError>: UPDATE read_at WHERE id=?; advance state
7. get_changes_since(since_state: &str) -> Result<ChangesResult, KithError>:
   a. Parse state counter from 'since-{n}' format
   b. SELECT messages created or updated with state_version > n
   c. Return added + updated lists and new_state string
   NOTE: store a state_version INTEGER column updated on each write to enable this query
8. get_state/advance_state: type_name='message'

**Algorithm note for state_version:** Add column state_version INTEGER to messages table in KITH-k64 migration. On each insert/update, set state_version = (SELECT counter FROM state_counters WHERE type_name='message') AFTER incrementing.

**Defensive programming rules:**
- Message IDs are server-assigned ULIDs; never trust a caller-supplied ID for routing
- created_at is the server's unix timestamp; sent_at_peer is stored as text for display only
- All params use params! macro
- get_changes_since returns KithError::Jmap(JmapError::cannot_calculate_changes()) if since_state not parseable or too old

**Tests:**
- Insert then get returns identical Message
- list_by_chat returns messages in created_at descending order (oracle: manually computed insertion order)
- update_delivery_state changes state and advances state token
- get_changes_since with state token from before insert includes new message in added list
- get_changes_since with current state token returns empty lists

**Acceptance:** cargo test -p kith-store: all MessageStore tests pass; no unwrap; clippy clean.
